Project : DUR 
Client : Medco, U.S 
Role : Software Test Engineer 
Testing Process  :  UFT Automation

Description: 
 
Drug Utilization Review – It is an application where every claim passes through for review. DUR process determines whether or 
not a drug in a prescription meets specifications for use as detailed in rules. Rules (Provided by Clinical Rule Station) gen erally 
are of a clinical or financial basis. As a result of meeting a condition, a claim may be rejected or a warning produced or passed.

Project : Personal Umbrella 
Client : EXIDE 
Role : Test Engineer 
Testing Process : Manual Testing 
Description: 
➢ Umbrella insurance is extra liability insurance. It is designed to help protect you from major claims and lawsuits and as 
a result it helps protect your assets and your future. It does this in two ways: 
➢ 1.Provides additional liability coverage above the limits of your homeowners, auto, and boat insurance policies. This 
protection is designed to kick in when the liability on these other policies has been exhausted. 
➢ 2.Provides coverage for claims that may be excluded by others.

PROJECT : 4 
 
Project : Canada Post 
Client : Innova Post 
Role : Test Engineer 
Testing Process : UFT Testing /API testing/ Functional Testing 
Description 
Canada Post is Canada's primary Crown postal operator, serving over 16 million addresses nationwide. Innova Post served as 
the dedicated IT shared services provider delivering technology solutions to support postal operations. The project involved 
end-to-end quality assurance of EST Online and EST 2.0 — enterprise mailing platforms supporting domestic and international 
shipments for individual and business customers. The platforms handled various mailing types catering to a wide range of 
customer needs across the Canadian postal ecosystem. 
 
Responsibilities: 
 
• Led a team of 3 offshore QA engineers and acted as the direct liaison between 6 offshore developers and the QA 
function, ensuring efficient communication of defects, test outcomes, and blockers. 
• Performed Regression, Sanity, Functional, and API Testing across EST Online and EST 2.0 using UFT, Katalon Studio, 
Postman, Ready API. 
• Logged and tracked all bugs and defects in JIRA with appropriate priority and severity tagging for timely resolution. 
• Served as the primary QA resource for a major Java 8 to Java 11 Security upgrade, executing the full regression suite 
and reporting several critical production-impacting defects. 
• Played a key QA role in the De Minimis tariff change project, validating updated trade threshold calculations between 
USA and Canada. 
• Conducted monthly Blue/Green deployment landing tests in production and performed post-deployment validation to 
ensure all functionalities were working as expected. 
• Attended daily Scrum stand-ups, participated in sprint planning, and provided weekly status reports to the QA lead 
and project manager.
